Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Geometric Diamond Jacquard Reversible Throw Blanket, 50" x 60", Black / White
Colors: Black
Made in Portugal, this throw features a modern geometric design. The bold color palette, artful fringe and jacquard pattern on the reverse side make it particularly beautiful when draped over the edge of a sofa or arm chair. 50"W x 60"L 50% cotton/50% acrylic Dry clean for best results. Can be washed on delicate cycle and line dried.
